description: Polish standard precast pretensioned T-girders by Mosty-Łódź S.A. (catalogue editions 2002/2005/2010; still produced by Mosty-Łódź, Betard, FABUD WKB, SIBET). T-section with a tapered/bulbed stem: top flange 890 mm wide, web 200 mm at the top widening continuously to B at the soffit. The type number is the nominal catalogue span in metres. T15 and T18 share one cross-section (750/360). NOTE: T22 does not exist in this family.

sources.table: Betard product page 'Belka mostowa T' (read directly from Wayback capture https://web.archive.org/web/20241204131619/https://betard.pl/produkty/belka-mostowa-t) attested identically by SIBET (https://p.izbudujemy.pl/inzynierbudownictwa/pliki/21_Sibet.pdf); corroborated by Gąćkowski 2018 (T27: 0.89 m flange, web 0.20→0.465 m; catalogue spacing 0.90 m) and Cieśla/Biskup/Skawiński, Drogi i Mosty 1/2009 (T27 provenance, B45, 22 strands).
sources.validation_note: No published A/yc/Ixx tables exist in the captured sources; validation is internal consistency (polygon vs closed-form trapezoidal-stem values) plus the attested cross-sectional constants. The ~210 mm top flange thickness is attested second-hand (Cieśla 2013, for T27) and is a constructor parameter - confirm per Mosty-Łódź catalogue before structural use.
